label: Figure 7.
caption: Figure 7. Physical stability of DX-LNPs. LNPs demonstrated stability for at least one month (1M) when stored at 4 ◦C and protected from light, with no significant changes observed in size (a), PDI (b), Z pot (c), and mRNA EE% (d). One-way ANOVA followed by Fisher’s LSD test was used to compare among groups: ns (not significant; p > 0.05).
